input.text: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000.
input.heading: Policy statements

input.text: Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file, unless the wire goes to an account the customer has used in the past year.
input.heading: Additional requirements

input.text: Callbacks are completed by a wire specialist, never by the employee who took the request.
